statement.p: Parameterize the line through P = \left(-2,-4\right) and Q = \left(1,4\right) so that the points P and Q correspond to the parameter values t = 6 and 8.

static.solution:
\overrightarrow{0P} = -2 \vec i - 4 \vec j from the origin to the point P and the displacement vector \overrightarrow{PQ} = 3 \vec i + 8 \vec j from P to Q.
\vec r(t) = \overrightarrow{OP} + \frac{(t - 6)}{2}\overrightarrow{PQ} or \vec r(t) = (-2 + 3\, \frac{(t - 6)}{2})\vec i + (-4 + 8\, \frac{(t - 6)}{2})\vec j.
